notes.title: V 0.1.0.10 Visual Update!
notes.content:
Meet the new graphics update!

Quality updates of tile marking markers and full interface screens have been made!

A demo version for those who are hesitant is also available now!

notes.title: V 0.1.0.9 Update
notes.content:
Check 2 new items in capitalist mode!

[b]Proxy Scanner[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139345/690862a5c5a87cf6a8639ed171bc5b263922a735.png[/img]

You still haven't found the loot? Feel the same sensitivity as animal sensations!
Proxy Scanner can be used to check the effect of rotating quickly when approaching loot.
Turn on your warning lights and explore your surroundings!

[b]Dummy Car[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139345/44cbeb4630960bd8c44331af4e1d2e08641f3da7.png[/img]

Meet a new servant for the route! Dummy car will check the tiles without our damage!
Place your vehicle and check the tiles in the vertical column!
